blocks.title: What SK hynix is
blocks.text: Korea's second memory maker and the HBM leader: DRAM (incl. HBM) is ~77% of revenue, NAND (incl. Solidigm, the former Intel NAND unit) most of the rest. Main supplier of HBM to Nvidia. Fabs in Icheon and Cheongju (M15X for HBM DRAM), Yongin cluster under construction, Wuxi and Dalian in China, an HBM packaging plant planned in Indiana. Listed in Seoul (000660) and, since July 2026, on Nasdaq as ADSs (SKHY). Totals here are OpenDART K-IFRS consolidated figures; the latest quarter not yet in DART comes from the earnings release.
